entries.zh: 安设尊位；为尊者安排位次，使之就位
entries.en: to prepare or settle a place of dignity; to install a seat of honor
entries.notes: M 栏一声调记号污损（T99），音证不全；义据 H 安位与 L 词头 aparejar el lugar de dignidad 互证。

entries.zh: 安设座位；安置尊座，使就座
entries.en: to prepare or dress the seat (chair of honor); to set a seat in place
entries.notes: M 栏一声调记号污损（T99），音证不全；义据 H 安座与 L 词头 aparejar, adereçar la silla 互证。

entries.zh: 便利齐备，准备停当；便于使用
entries.en: ready, prepared, in readiness; convenient, handy

entries.zh: 效命至死，舍身效劳；甘愿赴死
entries.en: ready to die; to serve unto death, to risk one's life in service

entries.zh: 以油烹煮伊；像治肴馔一样调治他
entries.en: to cook him; to prepare a round of boiling oil for him (to fry him)

entries.zh: 相貌，外表；形相
entries.en: appearance; outward figure, form

entries.zh: 相貌，容貌；形貌
entries.en: appearance, looks; figure, physiognomy

entries.zh: 姿态，仪态；神情态度
entries.en: appearance, demeanor; manner, carriage
entries.notes: M 栏残缺（T99），据 H 態、L apariencia 与 R 对音定义；L 栏后段（Talte day）难解。

entries.zh: 恭谨谦卑之貌；畏怯的神情
entries.en: humble appearance; a deferential, fearful look
entries.notes: H 栏标注[疑:恂/怕]；对音 zûn 与 apariencia humilde 之义更合恂字，故从恂。

entries.zh: 避开，躲避；远离
entries.en: to avoid, shun; to keep away from

entries.zh: 避居世外；遁世隐居，不涉尘俗
entries.en: to withdraw from the world; to live in retirement as a recluse

entries.zh: 避开邪祟；远离偶像崇拜及诸般恶习
entries.en: to shun evil and superstition; to turn away from idolatry and other vices
entries.notes: H 栏标注[疑:邪/妞]；西语义 idolatría/vicios 与邪字相合，故从邪。

entries.zh: 避开他人；躲人避面，隐避不出
entries.en: to keep apart from others; to hide oneself, avoid being seen

entries.zh: 让出尊位；辞避职位而退
entries.en: to vacate one's place or office of dignity; to resign a position

entries.zh: 分别，分开；离析
entries.en: to part, separate; to divide

entries.zh: 离别而去；走出，退出
entries.en: to go apart, go away; to leave, walk out

entries.zh: 背离道理；分开、别置一旁（与理相离）
entries.en: to depart from reason; to separate off, set apart

entries.zh: 走开，离开；离去
entries.en: to go away, depart; to leave

entries.zh: 开离而去；走开，离去
entries.en: to go away, depart; to leave off

entries.zh: 离开，抽身而去；撒手了事
entries.en: to leave, depart; to withdraw and let the matter go (be off)

entries.zh: 离散；四散分离（亲人离散）
entries.en: to scatter, be dispersed; to be separated (of kin or companions)

entries.zh: 离别；与人分别而去
entries.en: to part from, take leave of; separation
